data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 神社前的石阶
data.description: 蕾娜在石阶前停下来，先把手里的小册子收好。抬头看到鸟居时，她忍不住笑了：这次没有走错路。
data.action: standing before the shrine steps and looking at the torii
data.promptProse: Standing at the base of moss-covered stone stairs leading up into a dense, misty cedar grove, Lena looks upward toward a weathered vermilion torii gate after tucking away her travel guidebook. Sunlight streams through the towering forest canopy in ethereal god rays, illuminating swirling morning mist and stone lantern shrines.
